workflows.name: Daily Assistant
workflows.description: Ask questions, brainstorm ideas, get advice. Your private ChatGPT replacement.
tips: Use Qwen 2.5 7B for best quality on budget GPUs
Phi-4 Mini is great for CPU-only setups
Models remember context in the same session

workflows.name: Coding Assistant
workflows.description: Write, debug, and refactor code. Explain complex functions. Generate boilerplate.
tips: DeepSeek R1 excels at debugging and reasoning about code
Qwen 2.5 7B is best for code generation and completion
Use Ollama with Continue.dev plugin for VS Code integration

workflows.name: Writing & Research
workflows.description: Draft articles, edit content, summarize research papers, analyze documents.
tips: Use Qwen 3 14B for long-form writing and research analysis
Gemma 4 12B excels at following complex writing instructions
32K+ context models can analyze entire research papers

workflows.name: AI Agents & Automation
workflows.description: Build automated workflows, multi-step reasoning tasks, and agent chains.
tips: Qwen 3.5 27B is the best open model for agent workflows
DeepSeek R1's chain-of-thought is excellent for multi-step planning
Combine with LangChain or CrewAI for complex agent pipelines

workflows.name: Chat with Documents
workflows.description: Ask questions about PDFs, codebases, transcripts. Extract insights from long documents.
tips: Use models with 32K+ context for full document analysis
Qwen 3 14B handles 32K context windows comfortably on 12GB VRAM
Pair with Open WebUI or AnythingLLM for RAG workflows

workflows.name: Learning & Tutoring
workflows.description: Explain concepts, generate practice problems, tutor through difficult topics.
tips: Phi-4 Mini is excellent at explaining concepts clearly
Ask models to 'explain like I'm 5' for simpler explanations
Smaller models are fine for learning - speed matters less for study
